events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — Cameron Heyward figures the Pittsburgh Steelers can make some noise in the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers top Lamar-less Ravens 17-10, will make the playoffs if Buffalo or Jacksonville loses

events.name: Houston Texans at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Rookie quarterback C.J. Stroud made all the right calls in the biggest game of his NFL career to help the Houston Texans secure a playoff spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans wrap up playoff spot with 23-19 victory over Colts

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — With a mostly meaningless loss to the Bengals in the books, the Browns could turn their attention to preparing for their first playoff game in three years.
headlines.shortLinkText: With Browns resting starters for the playoffs, motivated Bengals win 31-14 to finish above .500

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Detroit Lions coach Dan Campbell was determined to close the regular season with a win, taking the risk of getting players hurt in hopes of moving from the No. 3 to the No. 2 seed in the NFC and...
headlines.shortLinkText: Playoff-bound Lions lose record-breaking rookie Sam LaPorta to knee injury in 30-20 win over Vikings

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — Trevor Lawrence called his own number on fourth-and-goal at the 1, stretching the ball out with the right arm that had him questionable for a game the Jacksonville Jaguars had to win to reach the playoffs for...
headlines.shortLinkText: Lawrence stopped short of goal line as Jags eliminated from playoff race in 28-20 loss to Titans

events.name: New York Jets at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Bill Belichick says he put everything he had into this season and still enjoys coaching.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bill Belichick loses in possible finale as Patriots coach. Jets snap 15-game skid vs New England

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Derek Carr and the New Orleans Saints' offense produced when they had to — and when they didn't.
headlines.shortLinkText: Derek Carr passes for 4 TDs, Saints rout Falcons but miss playoffs when Packers win

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — The Tampa Bay Buccaneers are headed to the playoffs for the fourth straight season — and they have their defense to thank.
headlines.shortLinkText: Buccaneers clinch NFC South title with 9-0 win over Panthers

events.name: Chicago Bears at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Jordan Love accomplished something in his first season as a starting quarterback that his four-time MVP predecessor failed to achieve last year.
headlines.shortLinkText: Love comes through as Packers beat Bears 17-9 to clinch a playoff berth

events.name: Denver Broncos at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — The “AP!” chants began with 1:01 left, Raiders fans joining the players in making known their preference that Antonio Pierce goes from interim to full-time coach.
headlines.shortLinkText: O'Connell, White and pass rush lead Raiders to 27-14 win over Broncos in season finale

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Jalen Hurts' dangling, contorted finger needed a quick fix. As Hurts waited on the sideline for a tape job, he casually, innocently extended his middle finger — though no...
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles complete late-season collapse, finish 1-5 stretch with 27-10 loss to New York Giants

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Cornerback Quandre Diggs and the Seahawks weren't exactly sure how to act in the minutes following their come-from-behind victory Sunday. The emotions came in waves — sometimes proud, other times dejected.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks rally for 21-20 win over Cardinals, but still miss out on playoffs after Packers win

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Blaine Gabbert showed he's ready to step in for the Kansas City Chiefs should something happen to Patrick Mahomes in the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mike Edwards' scoop-and-score, Harrison Butker's field goals propel Chiefs past Chargers 13-12

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Carson Wentz did his job filling in for Matthew Stafford, and now Stafford gets the chance for a highly anticipated playoff matchup against his former team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carson Wentz leads the Rams to the NFC's 6th seed with a 21-20 win over the 49ers

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — After Dak Prescott connected with CeeDee Lamb on a touchdown pass late in the first half Sunday to help the Dallas Cowboys clinch the NFC East...
headlines.shortLinkText: Dak Prescott and the Dallas Cowboys win the NFC East by beating the Commanders 38-10

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — Josh Allen walked toward the thousands of Bills fans who made their way to South Florida for the weekend, waving his arms as they showered him with postgame cheers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen rallies Bills for 21-14 win over Dolphins. Buffalo secures No. 2 seed in AFC

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — As the games get bigger, C.J. Stroud just keeps getting better.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stroud becomes youngest QB to win a playoff game as Texans rout Browns 45-14

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — It was so cold that Patrick Mahomes' helmet shattered on a hit. Andy Reid's mustache froze on the sideline. Fans and players alike huddled for...
headlines.shortLinkText: Patrick Mahomes leads Chiefs to 26-7 playoff win over Dolphins in near-record low temps

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Aaron Jones grew up idolizing Emmitt Smith and the Dallas Cowboys.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Love and the Packers pull a wild-card stunner, beating Dak Prescott and the Cowboys 48-32

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Jared Goff lifted his arms in the air, encouraging Ford Field fans to get even louder, before taking the final snap to end his long-suffering franchise's skid in the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jared Goff leads Lions to first playoff win in 32 years, 24-23 over Matthew Stafford and the Rams

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Buffalo Bills

notes.headline: AFC Wild Card Playoffs - originally scheduled on Jan. 14

headlines.description: — It made no difference to Josh Allen what day or time the Buffalo Bills faced the Pittsburgh Steelers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen, Bills dispatch Steelers 31-17 in playoff game delayed a day by snow. Chiefs up next

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — All Baker Mayfield and the resurgent Tampa Bay Buccaneers wanted was an opportunity to make some noise in the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mayfield throws for 337 yards and 3 TDs to lead Buccaneers to 32-9 NFC wild-card rout of Eagles

events.name: Houston Texans at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — Lamar Jackson had already done plenty of running by the time he reached the end zone in the fourth quarter.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lamar Jackson and Ravens pull away in the second half to beat Texans 34-10 and reach AFC title game

events.name: Green Bay Packers at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Brock Purdy's throws were off-target all night. The San Francisco defense kept giving up big plays. There were even a couple of special teams blunders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Christian McCaffrey's 2nd TD rallies the 49ers to 24-21 playoff win over Jordan Love and the Packers

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Jared Goff is good enough for Detroit, as his coach recently reminded him.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jared Goff throws 2 TD passes, Lions advance to NFC title game with 31-23 win over Buccaneers

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — No matter the setting — Arrowhead Stadium or Orchard Park — Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs keep finding ways to beat Josh Allen and Buffalo Bills in the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kelce scores twice and Chiefs beat Bills 27-24 to advance to face Ravens in AFC championship

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — The first quarter was vintage Patrick Mahomes, picking apart the Baltimore defense with quick passes, with Travis Kelce on the other end of several of them.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patrick Mahomes, Travis Kelce are headed back to the Super Bowl after Chiefs shut down Ravens 17-10

events.name: Detroit Lions at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Brock Purdy and the San Francisco 49ers were on the brink, needing a spark to overcome a big deficit and avoid a third straight loss in the conference title game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brock Purdy, 49ers rally from 17 points down, beat Lions 34-31 to advance to Super Bowl
